post.description: Web session only: a bearer token answers 401 not_authenticated.
Web session only. A bearer token (even a valid one) is not accepted here and answers 401 not_authenticated; a session without a valid CSRF token answers 403.

Upload a scanned document as multipart/form-data: `metadata` is a JSON string (schema `UploadMetadataIn`), followed by one `page` file (image/jpeg) per page in page order. Repeating an upload with the same `client_id` and pages answers 200 with the existing document.
